title: Data-Quality Trust Score Contract (DC-DQ-TRUSTSCORE-v1)
description: Sprint 31 Data Quality Agent (DQA) contract for a per-domain, deterministic, versioned Trust Score over the gold/serving decision layer that grounds Fabric IQ / Foundry IQ. One record is one domain assessment: an overall score in [0,1], a per-dimension breakdown (completeness, timeliness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, lineage-integrity, provenance, ontology-mapping), the model version that produced it, and the as-of timestamp. The score is a pure function of its dimension inputs (data-platform/quality/trust_score.py) — NEVER an LLM estimate — so it is reproducible and explainable (design spec Sec 6, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-27-sprint-31-32-signal-and-data-quality-agents-design.md). Advisory + HITL + read-only; no PHI by construction (aggregate domain metadata only). See docs/adr/0053-dqa-trust-score-model.md.

domain.description: The gold/serving domain assessed, e.g. staffing.skills.

score.description: Overall trust score in [0,1] — the weighted aggregate of the dimensions.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension quality scores, each in [0,1]. The eight canonical dimensions of the trust-score model (design Sec 6).

decisionClass.description: Optional decision class whose weighting produced the score; thresholds are ADR-ratified per decision class.

modelVersion.description: Deterministic trust-score model version, e.g. trustscore-v1. Bumps when weights/dimensions change.
